content: Hizqiyaasi Isayaasa Zore Oychis
Kawoy Hizqiyaasi hessa si7ida wode ba ma7uwa peedhidi, kayo ma7o ma7idi, Godaa keethi gelis.
Kawo gadho aysiya Eliyaqeemi, xaafey Sheebinne kaalethiya kahineti kayo ma7o ma7idi, Amoxe na7aa nabiya Isayaasako baana mela kiittis.
Enti Isayaasako bidi, Hizqiyaasi haysada yaagees: “Ha gallasay meto gallas, seera gallasinne yeella gallas. Hessika na7i yeletanaw wodey gakin, bannakada yelanaw wolqi dhayida maccasa mela gidida.

De7o Xoossaa cayanaada iya goday, Asoore kawoy, kiitida halaqaa qaala Goday ne Xoossay si7onna aggenna. Qassi Goday ne Xoossay he qaala gaason iya seeronna aggenna. Hessa gisho, asaa giddofe attanaysatas woossa” yaagidosona.
Kawoy Hizqiyaasi kiittidaysa Isayaasi si7ida wode,
entako, “Hinte godaas haysada yaagidi odite: Goday, ‘Asoore kawa aylleti tana cayishin, neeni si7ida cashsha qaalas yayyofa.
Heko, I oda si7idi, ba biitta simmana mela, taani iya giddon issi ayyaana yeddana. Yaatada I ba biitta bidi yan mashshan hayqanaada oothana’ yaagees” yaagidi kiittis.
Asoore kawoy Laakiso katamaape dendidi bidaysa Asoore halaqay si7idi, guye simmidi kawoy Libina kataman oleteysa demmis.
Kawoy Sanakreemi, “Tophe kawoy Tirihaaqi nena olanaw yis” giya odaa si7idi, Hizqiyaasas haysada yaagidi kiittis.
“Yihuda kawa Hizqiyaasa, neeni ammanetiya Xoossay, ‘Yerusalaame Asoore kawa kushen yeggenna’ yaagidi cimmofo.
Asoore kawoti biittata ubbaa waati dhaysidaako neeni si7adasa. Yaatin, neeni attanee?
Beni ta mayzati dhaysida Gozaana, Kaaranenne Rafeesa biitta xoossatinne Talasaaran de7iya Edene biitta xoossati he biittata dhayope ashshidonaa?
Hamaata kawoy, Arfada kawoy, Safarwayma kawoy, Heena kawoynne Iwa kawoy awun de7oona?” yaagidi kiittis.
Hizqiyaasa Woosa
Hizqiyaasi dabdaabiya kiitetida asaape ekidi nabbabis. Dabdaabiya Godaa keethi efidi Godaa sinthan miccis.
Godaa haysada yaagidi woossis:
“Abeeti Ubbaafe Wolqaama Godaw, kiruubetape gidduwan uttida Isra7eele Xoossaw, sa7a kawotethata ubbaa bolla ne xalaali Xoosse. Saluwanne sa7aa neeni medhadasa.
Abeeti Godaw, ne haytha yeggada haa si7a. Abeeti Godaw, ne ayfiya dooyada haa xeella. Nena, de7o Xoossaa, Sanakreemi cayida cashshaa si7a.
“Abeeti Godaw, Asoore kawoti kawotethatanne enta biitta dhaysidaysi ee tuma.
Enta xoossata taman xuuggidi dhaysidosona; Enta xoossati kaseka asa kushey massidi kessida mithinne shuchi gidiya gisho, xoossata gidokona.
Hiza abeeti Godaw, nu Xoossaw, ne xalaali Godaa gideysa sa7aa kawotethati ubbay erana mela neeni nuna iya kushepe ashsha” yaagidi woossis.
Sanakreema Kundethaa
Hessafe guye, Amoxe na7ay Isayaasi Hizqiyaasas haysada yaagidi kiittis: Goday, Isra7eele Xoossay haysada yaagees: “Neeni Asoore kawa Sanakreema gaason tana woossida woosa taani si7as” yaagees.

content.text: Yerusalaame na7iya ba huuphiya qaathada nena borasu.
Ne oodde bolla ne qaala dhoqu oothada odetadii?
Ne otoron oona dhoqu gada xeelladii?
Hessa ne oothiday Isra7eele Geeshshaa bollana gidennee?
Neeni kiitida asaa baggara Godaa cayadasa.
haatha olla bookada haathe iyape uyas.

content: yaagadasa.

Hessa gisho, enta asaas wolqay ixin,
Enti keethaa huuphen doliya maata melanne
ta bolla ne hanqetida hanquwa erayis.

content: Isayaasi kawa Hizqiyaasako haysada yaagis. “Hessi poletanaysas mallay haysa; ha laythinne wonto laythi hinte aasebo kaxida kathi maana. Shin heedzantho laythan hinte, hinte huuphen zeritenne cakite; woyne tokitenne iya ayfiya miite.
Yihuda asaape attidaysati xapho yeddana; ayfe ayfana.
Attida guuthati Yerusalaamepenne Xiyoone deriyape yaana. Ubbaafe Wolqaama Godaa qanaatey hessa oothana.

“Hessa gisho, Asoore kawuwaba Goday haysada yaagees. Asoore kawoy ha katamaa gelenna; woyko haysan ba dongiya dukenna; woyko ba gondalliya oykidi, ha katamaa sinthe aadhenna; woyko katamaa yuushuwa teqenna.
Asoore kawoy ba yida ogiyara guye simmana; ha katamaa gelenna.” Taani Goday haysa odayis.
“Taani ta bonchuwa gishonne ta aylliya Dawita gisho, ha katamaa ashshana” yaagis.
He qamma Godaa kiitanchoy keyidi, Asoore asay dunkaanida guta bidi, 185,000 addeta wodhis. Wontetha gallas asay dendidi ahi aha bolla dooretidaysa be7idosona.
Hessa gisho, Asoore kawoy Sanakreema dendidi, guye simmi bidi Nanawe kataman uttis.
Issi gallas Sanakreema ba xoossaa Nisirooka keethan goyinnishin, iya nayti Adramelekinne Sarxari mashshan iya wodhidi Araraate biitta baqatidosona. Iya na7ay Asiradooni iya bessan kawotis.
